operating_notes.text: SCI owns 58 vessels (avg age 15.5 yrs) with total 52.61 lakh DWT, and manages 40 vessels as of March 2026.
Signed MoU in Sep 2025 with BPCL, HPCL/ONGC, and IOCL to jointly acquire, own, and operate energy transport vessels.
Signed MoU in Feb 2026 with CONCOR, JNPA, VOCPA, CPA, and SMFCL for end-to-end container logistics assets.
BSE and NSE levied fines of ₹5.31 lakh each for Regulation 17(1) board composition non-compliance.
Board noted fine of ₹5.43 lakh (inclusive of GST) each by NSE and BSE for Q3 FY26 board composition non-compliance and sought fine waiver.

timeline.summary: Smt. Swapnita Vikas Yadav, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on SCI’s equity shares for FY 2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 01.04.2026.
Shipping Corporation of India Limited’s Board, led by Smt. Swapnita Vikas Yadav, recommended a ₹1 (10%) final dividend per ₹10 equity share on May 8, 2026, pending AGM approval.
SCI published its FY26 investor presentation highlighting fleet expansion plans, VLGC inductions, and ongoing tenders for 14 new vessels.
Shipping Corporation Of India Limited hosted a conference call on May 11, 2026, to discuss Q4 FY2025-26 results, with audio recording available via the provided link.
2026-05-27: BSE and NSE levied fines of ₹5.31 lakh each on SCI for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) on board composition.
Shipping Corporation of India disclosed Board comments regarding ₹5.43 lakh exchange fines for Q3 FY26 board composition non-compliance and requested fee waivers.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend of Re 1 per share at the ensuing AGM
Appointment of requisite number of independent directors including an independent woman director by the Competent Authority
Waiver approval of non-compliance fines by NSE and BSE
